title: Paid SSC CHSL - antonym PART (I) (2024)

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Shame
questions.solution:
C) Shame(noun) – A painful feeling of humiliation or distress caused by the consciousness of wrong or foolish behavior. लज्जा
ANTONYM: Pride(noun) – A feeling of deep pleasure or satisfaction derived from one's own achievements, the achievements of one's close associates, or from qualities or possessions that are widely admired. गर्व

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.
His opponents viewed him as stubborn, dogmatic, and inflexible
questions.solution:
A)Dogmatic(adjective) – Inclined to lay down principles as incontrovertibly true, rigid, inflexible, uncompromising. कट्टर/ हठधर्मी
Antonym:Amenable(adjective) – Open and responsive to suggestion, easily persuaded or controlled, flexible. जवाबदेह

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word ‘bold’ in the given sentence.
A person can be friendly, timid, clever, or fearless based on the context of the situation
questions.solution:
B)Bold(adjective) – Confident, courageous, daring, fearless. साहसी
Antonym:Timid(adjective) – Showing a lack of courage or confidence, easily frightened. डरपोक

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.
It is no exaggeration to say the Hussain Sagar Lake is an integral element of Hyderabad and Hyderabad’s history.
questions.solution:
B) Integral(adjective) – Necessary to make a whole complete; essential or fundamental. अखंड / अभिन्न
Antonym:Extra(adjective) – Added to an existing or usual amount or number; additional, surplus, not essential.अतिरिक्त

questions.question:
Read the given sentence carefully. Change the meaning of the sentence by replacing the underlined word with its ANTONYM from the following options.
The equivocal tone of the Prime Minister in his speech caused uproar in the chamber
questions.solution:
D)Equivocal(adjective) – Open to more than one interpretation; ambiguous, unclear, or uncertain. द्विअर्थी
Antonym:Explicit(adjective) – Stated clearly and in detail, leaving no room for confusion or doubt; clear, unambiguous. स्पष्ट

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.
My parents have a fertile land in the backyard.
questions.solution:
D)Fertile(adjective) – (of soil or land) producing or capable of producing abundant vegetation or crops. उपजाऊ
Antonym:Barren(adjective) – (of land) too poor to produce much or any vegetation, unproductive. बाँझ

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.
The dearth of governmental policies on the basic rights and comforts of the impaired population leads to low standard of public life in a country.
questions.solution:
A) Dearth(noun) – A scarcity or lack of something. कमी
Antonym:Abundance(noun) – A very large quantity of something, plenty, profusion. प्रचुरता

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the sentence.
He laboured very hard but could not yield anything from the barren piece of land
questions.solution:
A) Barren (adjective)– Unproductive, infertile, desolate, arid, unfruitful.बंजर
Antonym: Fertile (adjective)– Capable of producing abundant vegetation or crops, fruitful, productive, rich.उपजाऊ

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Enemy
questions.solution:
D)Enemy(noun) – A person who is actively opposed or hostile to someone or something. शत्रु
Antonym:Friend(noun) – A person with whom one has a bond of mutual affection, typically one exclusive of sexual or family relations. मित्र

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Lethargic
questions.solution:
C)Lethargic(adjective) – Sluggish, lacking energy, inactive, slow. सुस्त
Antonym:Active(adjective) – Energetic, lively, vigorous, dynamic. सक्रिय

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in brackets to fill in the blank.
The firefighter summoned all her _________ (cowardice) and rushed into the burning building.
questions.solution:
C)Cowardice(noun) – Lack of bravery, fearfulness, timidity. कायरता
Antonym:Courage(noun) – The ability to do something that frightens one, bravery, valor, heroism. साहस

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.
The truth was revealed in the interrogation
questions.solution:
C)Revealed(verb) – Made known, disclosed, uncovered, exposed. प्रकट किया
Antonym:Concealed(verb) – Kept secret, hidden, covered up, obscured. छिपाया

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.
We should desecrate our national flag
questions.solution:
A)Desecrate(verb) – To treat (a sacred place or thing) with violent disrespect; violate. अपवित्र करना
Antonym:Sanctify(verb) – To set apart as or declare holy; consecrate. पवित्र करना

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.
She was known for her refined manners.
questions.solution:
C)Refined(adjective) – Polished, sophisticated, cultured, elegant, well-mannered. परिष्कृत
Antonym:Crude(adjective) – Lacking refinement or sophistication, raw, unrefined, rough. असभ्य/ अशोधित

questions.question:
Identify the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Lenient
questions.solution:
A)Lenient(adjective) – Merciful, tolerant, not harsh or strict. उदार/ सौम्‍य
Antonym:Strict(adjective) – Demanding that rules concerning behavior are obeyed and observed, stringent, severe. सख्त

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Adverse
questions.solution: D)Adverse(adjective) – Unfavorable, harmful, detrimental, hostile. प्रतिकूलAntonym:Propitious(adjective) – Favorable, auspicious, promising, beneficial. अनुकूल

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.
Please don’t touch that, it’s flammable
questions.solution:
D) Flammable(adjective) – Easily set on fire, combustible, inflammable. ज्वलनशील
Antonym: Non-combustible(adjective) – Not able to catch fire and burn easily, fireproof. अग्निरोधक

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word ‘Contaminate’ from the given sentence.
She spent the entire night working non-stop to clean the blood stains from the rug
questions.solution:
D)Contaminate(verb) – To make something impure or unsuitable by contact or mixture with something unclean, bad, etc. दूषित करना.
Antonym:Clean(verb) – To make something free of dirt, marks, or mess, साफ करना.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.
Anthony Trollope was an industrious and disciplined writer
questions.solution: A)Industrious(adjective) – Hard-working, diligent, productive, assiduous. परिश्रमीAntonym:Lazy(adjective) – Unwilling to work or use energy, idle, indolent, sluggish. आलसी

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Fastidious
questions.solution:
C) Fastidious(adjective) – Very attentive to and concerned about accuracy and detail, meticulous, scrupulous.नकचढ़ा,तुनकमिजाज
Antonym:Lax(adjective) – Not sufficiently strict, severe, or careful, careless, negligent. ढीला, शिथिल
